Congratulations! You have successfully destroyed a Frigate. Even though this ship was weakened somewhat, it was still quite powerful. A real Frigate, or its Rebel counterpart, the Destroyer, is more difficult to defeat with a single Kestrel and fighters, but possible. We will not move on to the Cruiser, because the Academy does not wish to stir suicidal tendencies in its trainees. We strongly urge that you do not attempt to take on such a ship without a large complement of fighters and fighter-escorts. Your next missions will involve more combat and mission skills. Return to the Spaceport Bar when ready.
